findings.failureScenario: An implementer specifying the v1 session-close capture prompt reads meta/ and gets two incompatible instructions for the same flow. Implementer A follows constraints.md:293 and builds the PWA-push + in-app capture card as the v1 capture surface. Implementer B follows personas.md:81 (as 07.09.03:38 and 07.06.01:204 already do) and concludes a browser form is the one flow the capture persona will not use, so the v1 mechanism must either be redesigned or escalated as unviable before build. The wedge's only v1 capture path is what is in dispute, so the divergence is not cosmetic: it decides whether the v1 provenance mechanism ships at all, and nothing in meta/ says which statement is superseded.
findings.forcedInvention: Whether the Producer's 'no web form' constraint is superseded by D-70 (and therefore whether the PWA/in-app capture card is an authorised v1 surface for the capture persona), or still binding (and therefore whether v1's capture mechanism must be redesigned). The implementer must invent the reconciliation, because neither file marks the other.

coverageNote: Expected 1 unit / 6 files; audited exactly 1 unit / 6 files — enumeration matches disk (meta/ holds competitive-landscape.md, constraints.md, counterparties.md, cross-cut-emergent-capabilities.md, personas.md, problem-statement.md; 1,259 lines total). All 8 vision dimensions were scored as applicable: meta/ is the unit that owns problem, personas, constraints and competitive positioning, and cross-cut-emergent-capabilities.md carries a feature/mechanism inventory, so no dimension was N/A. Dimension 8's domain-folder criteria (*-index.md, *-cx.md, Role Matrix) do not apply to meta/ since it is not a domain folder; it was scored on the remaining applicable criterion, Structure-Map-vs-disk agreement, which holds for file inventory but fails on the emergent counts and the status cells. Scoring maps findings to dimensions: a blocking finding makes its dimension FAIL (1.0), a warning makes it PARTIAL (0.5); Dimension 5 is PARTIAL on the rubric's literal 'directional only' criterion without a filed finding. Points 4.0 / 8 applicable = 50.0%. Six further candidate findings were refuted in the devil's-advocate pass and are recorded above with the reason each was dropped.
